title: The Carabao and the Shell
year_evidence: 扉に『Philippine Folk Tales / Compiled and Annotated by / Mabel Cook Cole / 1916』
text:
_Tinguian_

One very hot day, when a carabao went into the river to bathe, he
met a shell and they began talking together.

"You are very slow," said the carabao to the shell.

"Oh, no," replied the shell. "I can beat you in a race."

"Then let us try and see," said the carabao.

So they went out on the bank and started to run.

After the carabao had gone a long distance he stopped and called,
"Shell!"

And another shell lying by the river answered, "Here I am!"

Then the carabao, thinking that it was the same shell with which he
was racing, ran on.

By and by he stopped again and called, "Shell!"

Again another shell answered, "Here I am!"

The carabao was surprised that the shell could keep up with him. But
he ran on and on, and every time he stopped to call, another shell
answered him. But he was determined that the shell should not beat him,
so he ran until he dropped dead. [91]
paragraphs: _Tinguian_
One very hot day, when a carabao went into the river to bathe, he met a shell and they began talking together.
"You are very slow," said the carabao to the shell.
"Oh, no," replied the shell. "I can beat you in a race."
"Then let us try and see," said the carabao.
So they went out on the bank and started to run.
After the carabao had gone a long distance he stopped and called, "Shell!"
And another shell lying by the river answered, "Here I am!"
Then the carabao, thinking that it was the same shell with which he was racing, ran on.
By and by he stopped again and called, "Shell!"
Again another shell answered, "Here I am!"

The carabao was surprised that the shell could keep up with him. But he ran on and on, and every time he stopped to call, another shell answered him. But he was determined that the shell should not beat him, so he ran until he dropped dead. [91]
ティンギアン
たいそう暑いある日、カラバオが水浴びに川へ入っていくと、貝に出会い、そして二匹はともに話し始めた。
「おまえはたいそう遅い」とカラバオは貝に言った。
「いや、そんなことはない」と貝は答えた。「駆けくらべならおまえに勝てる。」
「それならやって見てみよう」とカラバオは言った。
そこで二匹は岸へ出て走り始めた。
カラバオが長い道を行ったあと、立ち止まって「貝よ!」と呼んだ。
すると川のかたわらに横たわっていた別の貝が答えた。「ここにいる!」
それからカラバオは、これが駆けくらべをしている同じ貝だと思って、走り続けた。
やがてまた立ち止まって「貝よ!」と呼んだ。
またしても別の貝が答えた。「ここにいる!」
カラバオは貝が自分について来られるのに驚いた。けれどもどこまでも走り、そして呼ぶために立ち止まるたびに、別の貝が答えた。けれども貝に負けるわけにはいかないと心に決めていたので、倒れて死ぬまで走った。[91]
